name: 3x3 EYES ~Kyuusei Koushu~
source:
Yakumo receives a message from his friend, the Buddhist monk Naparvha, saying that a curse has fallen upon a village in China. A young girl was killed under mysterious circumstances, and two monks fell asleep and cannot wake up. Yakumo visits the village and begins the investigation, aided by Yue Hua, the sister of the dead girl.

[From [url=https://www.mobygames.com/game/3x3-eyes-kysei-kshu]Mobygames[/url]]
